text: Generally speaking, there is but one way of securing and providing oneself against faults and inconveniences of this sort, not to be too hasty in bestowing our affection, and not to bestow it at all on unworthy objects.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
